factValues.name: gr:fact-e8a5bc4f1f334c3b_fv
factValues.value:
The company is under the control of Mr P Hughes, who is a director and the majority shareholder.
Mr P Hughes controls and is a director of Benchmark Security Installations Limited and Benchmark Security Group Management Services Limited.
During the year the company made payments etc. on behalf of the above companies and received funds on their behalf. At the year end Benchmark Security Installations Limited owed the company £151,309 (2024 - £144,986), Benchmark Security Group Management Sevices Limited owed the company £42,100 (2024 - 1,675), Benchmark Chauffer Limited owed the company £218 and Benchmark Facilities Limited owed the company £1,202. These amounts are shown in note 8 to the accounts.
